page08.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE new 16:9 raster explanatory image, ideally 1672x941.
Reference1: previous page08 STYLE ONLY, replace its composition completely. Reference2: mandatory TYPOGRAPHY ONLY; match rounded condensed handwritten Traditional Chinese and English marker letters, not brush calligraphy, no gears or copied wording.
Warm pale beige paper, faint subtle square grid, navy pen outlines with restrained hatch shading, blue/teal/coral accents. Simple semantic document/wrench/database/Context icons only, no robot, no brain, no hands/people, no cards/dashboard.
Core lesson: the stored complete data does not exist magically beforehand. A Tool first returns a large complete result; Runtime deliberately stores the original result so later tools can still use it, while preparing only what the model needs this round. This is an architecture choice illustrated here, not all tools automatically save to DB.
Exact title near top centered: "工具結果留完整，給模型的內容按需準備". Page "08" top-right. Title large, single line, no overlapping page number.
ONE clear left-to-right composition, three visual groups evenly spaced centered x20%, x50%, x80%, y46%. First group: orange Tool file+wrench with a visible thick stack of result sheets behind, label ABOVE "Tool 回傳", label BELOW "完整結果". Second group: large blue database storing a stack of identical original result sheets, ABOVE label "Runtime 保存", BELOW label "原始完整資料". Third group: teal Context folder with only a FEW extracted colored lines / one small sheet, ABOVE label "交給模型", BELOW label "本輪 Context".
Arrow from Tool result group into database, caption "保留原始結果". Arrow from database toward Context folder, caption "只取本輪需要". Connectors unambiguously left-to-right, attach arrowhead at receiving object, no reverse arrows, no crossings.
Below database at y73% ONE explanatory sentence in large navy handwriting: "後續工具仍可取用完整資料". A thin non-directional dotted leader links this caption to stored-data icon; this is explanation, not a fourth execution step.
This should visually contrast MANY retained pages vs FEW model-facing pages, while making origin and retention purpose explicit. Do not start diagram with database alone. Do not imply original full result is discarded or that a selection requirement is hard-coded for every workflow. No Data Ref text yet (introduced on later page).
Every necessary text comfortably large: minimum30pt visual-equivalent target, visible letter height approximately50-60px normalized1080; never shrink a label to fit. Title~84px normalized1080. If crowded, shrink ICONS or reduce icon detail, not text. All words above y80% of canvas; bottom20% entirely blank, top/sides6% clear. Labels separated from arrows and icons with generous whitespace. Use ONLY the exact quoted text, no footer, no chapter badge, no added subtitle.
